summary: Post-invoice credit redistribution requested after hourly meter reprocessing produced negative line and misapplied credits
description: Issue summary: Customer received March invoice with a -$1,230.00 negative line item labeled 'kv-cache-credit-reversal' dated 2026-03-09. The negative line appeared after our hourly reprocessing job reingested late usage postbacks. However, the overall invoice total still contains the original charge and the negative line does not appear to have been applied to the intended subaccount buckets. Customer is requesting: 1) explanation of why a negative line was created post-invoice, 2) redistribution of that credit to Subaccount B (subacc-b@nimbledocs) and Subaccount C (subacc-c@nimbledocs), and 3) reissued invoice or credit memo reflecting corrected allocations.
steps_to_reproduce:
1) Confirm original usage window: 2026-03-01T00:00:00Z to 2026-03-01T01:00:00Z where a large batch embedding job retried with duplicated postbacks.
2) Run hourly-aggregator reingest for that window on staging with late_postback=true.
3) Observe that postback dedupe created adjustment records and produced a negative 'kv-cache' credit line in the invoice preview.
4) Run invoice rendering job (billing-render-v2) to simulate final invoice; note that redistribution logic applied at org-level only and failed to assign to subaccounts due to missing subaccount mapping in reingest payload.
logs_and_evidence:
- Customer invoice PDF: invoice_2026-03-09_98765.pdf (attached in ticket).
- Aggregator job trace: s3://redwood-logs/aggregator/2026/03/01/run-1145.log (relevant entries: dedupe_id=aa7f4e, event=late_postback).
- Postback payload sample: postback_id=pb-77892 (contains org_id=nimbledocs, but subaccount_id field empty).
- Slack thread: #support (https://slack.redwood.com/archives/C02SUPPORT/p1642342345).
- Billing-render PR with logging change: https://github.com/redwood-inference/billing/pull/842
impact: Customer's finance team cannot reconcile March spend. They are a dedicated customer with committed monthly credits; misapplied refund causes reporting mismatch and may delay payment. NimbleDocs requested a credit memo or corrected invoice by EOB 2026-03-12.
investigation_notes: Initial triage (Aisha): negative line introduced by hourly-aggregator reingest that created adjustment record with 'kv-cache-credit-reversal' tag.
Confirmed late postbacks were deduped but the reingest payload omitted subaccount mapping for a subset of events — aggregator assigned org-level adjustment rather than subaccount-level.
Billing-render (Marco): invoice renderer applies org-level credits if subaccount mapping missing; this explains why negative line appeared but was not redistributed to subaccounts.
Hypothesis: a retry flow from the customer's batch embed worker omitted x-subaccount header when requests retried through an older gateway instance (gateway v0.9.3).
Temporary reproduction on staging using postback_id=pb-77892 reproduced the allocation bug consistently when subaccount_id absent.
Related historical ticket SUP-912345 noted similar behaviour when gateway failed to propagate subaccount header during 2026-01 incident.

2026-03-10 14:40 UTC - NimbleDocs (Finance) -> Support: Uploaded invoice and said that subaccount allocations are required for month-end close. Asked for ETA on fix.
2026-03-11 09:03 UTC - Marco Diaz (Billing Eng) -> Support: Confirmed cause and proposed workaround: issue a credit memo and reissue corrected invoice; investigating root cause in gateway.
2026-03-11 17:22 UTC - Support -> Customer: Provided interim credit memo schedule and requested list of subaccounts that should receive redistributed credit (they provided subacc-b@nimbledocs, subacc-c@nimbledocs).
resolution:
Workaround and short-term fix issued: 1) Created credit memo CM-2026-03-10-98765 for -$1,230.00 applied to NimbleDocs main account (Finance approved on 2026-03-12). 2) Manually redistributed amounts: $600 to subacc-b@nimbledocs and $630 to subacc-c@nimbledocs and reissued invoice INV-2026-03-09-98765-R1. 3) Notified customer and finance.
Long-term follow-up: engineering to patch gateway v0.9.3 to ensure x-subaccount header persists on retries (patch queued in billing/gateway repo PR #847) and add validation in hourly-aggregator to raise alert when adjustment records are created without subaccount mapping. Estimated timeline: patch in staging by 2026-03-18, rollout to prod 2026-03-22 after QA.
follow_up_actions: ENG: Deploy gateway hotfix to preserve subaccount header on retry (PR #847).
PLATFORM: Add aggregator validation that logs and opens an alert when adjustment record has org_id but no subaccount_id. (Runbook update: Hourly Aggregator reingest).
BILLING: Add reconciliation step to invoice rendering that flags post-invoice negative lines for manual review if any contain 'credit-reversal' tags and total invoice delta > $250.
CS: Confirm with NimbleDocs finance once corrected invoice is received and mark ticket Resolved after confirmation.
